def: a bird-trap (as furnished with a clap-stick or treadle to spring it); hence, a basket (as resembling a wicker cage)

words.word: unto me and behold a basket

occurrences.text: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.
Thus hath the Lord God shewed unto me: and behold a basket of summer fruit.
words: unto me and behold a basket

occurrences.text: And he said, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then said the Lord unto me, The end is come upon my people of Israel; I will not again pass by them any more.
